Arjun Reddy  
Tel Aviv, Israel | arjun.reddy@ecomm.innovations | +972-54-123-4567 | linkedin.com/in/arjunreddyml  

A decade of shaping intelligent systems at the intersection of e-commerce and machine learning, delivering scalable solutions that drive revenue growth and operational efficiency. Specializing in building end-to-end ML pipelines, optimizing recommendation engines, and architecting NLP-driven platforms. My work has consistently focused on operationalizing models at scale, reducing latency by over 40% in critical workflows, and mentoring cross-functional teams to adopt MLOps best practices.  

**Professional Experience**  
*Staff Machine Learning Engineer*  
**E-Commerce Innovations Ltd.** | 2019–present  
Architected a unified MLOps platform using MLflow and Weights & Biases, enabling seamless model deployment across 15+ microservices. Spearheaded the integration of Kubernetes for containerized ML workloads, reducing infrastructure costs by 25% while improving fault tolerance. Redesigned the company’s recommendation engine to support real-time personalization, increasing average order value by 18% through PyTorch-based collaborative filtering.  

*Senior ML Engineer*  
**GlobalEcom Corp** | 2017–2019  
Led the development of a scalable NLP pipeline for product categorization, reducing manual tagging efforts by 70% and improving classification accuracy to 92%. Engineered a distributed Spark cluster to process 10TB of customer interaction data daily, enabling faster insights for marketing strategies. Mentored 8+ junior engineers in deploying models on AWS, resulting in a 30% reduction in deployment delays.  

*ML Engineer*  
**RetailTech Solutions** | 2015–2017  
Built a recommendation system using TensorFlow that boosted click-through rates by 22% for high-margin products. Implemented a production-grade MLOps workflow with Docker and Airflow, cutting model retraining cycles from 7 days to 4 hours. Pioneered the use of AWS Lambda for event-driven model inference, reducing latency by 35% in real-time pricing scenarios.  

*Junior ML Engineer*  
**Startups Inc.** | 2013–2015  
Developed a data pipeline using Apache Spark to process 500M+ user events monthly, laying the foundation for later ML initiatives. Designed a Dockerized environment for model training, improving reproducibility across 12+ development teams.  

**Technical Skills**  
Apache Spark (production-scale data processing, ETL pipelines), Docker (containerization, CI/CD integration), MLOps (MLflow, Weights & Biases, model versioning), PyTorch (NLP, recommendation systems), TensorFlow (distributed training, custom embeddings), AWS (architecture design, EC2 clusters), Kubernetes (orchestration, autoscaling), NLP (sentiment analysis, intent recognition), Recommendation Systems (collaborative filtering, matrix factorization).  

**Projects**  
- **Smart Product Categorization System**: Built a multilingual NLP model using BERT and PyTorch to automate product tagging, reducing manual effort by 70% and improving search relevance.  
- **Real-Time Personalization Engine**: Developed a TensorFlow-based recommendation system that dynamically adjusts product suggestions based on user behavior, increasing conversion rates by 15%.  
- **Scalable Spark ETL Framework**: Designed a fault-tolerant Spark cluster to process terabytes of transactional data, enabling real-time analytics for inventory optimization.  
- **MLOps Platform for GlobalEcom**: Orchestrated the deployment of over 50 models using MLflow and Kubernetes, reducing deployment downtime by 40% and improving model monitoring capabilities.
